settings.title: Settings
settings.videoShortEdgeHint: Short edge pixels, keeps aspect ratio
settings.smartCropHint: Crops the active area of the frame before recognition, so people and objects look sharper at the same resolution; a full-view reference frame is sent along. Falls back to the whole frame when no active area is found.
settings.smartCropUnavailable: Not enabled on the server yet; not configurable for now.
settings.omniFpsHint: Higher frame rate uses more resources
settings.partialSaveFailed: Scheduler toggle saved, but perception settings failed to save. Please retry.
settings.restartFailed: Settings saved, but engine restart failed. Please restart manually.
settings.schedulerSaved: Saved. Takes effect after the next agent gateway restart.
settings.autoScheduleHint: When on, miloco auto-creates and maintains its built-in scheduled tasks (perception digest / home patrol / memory dreaming / habit insights). When off, those tasks are removed and not recreated. Takes effect after the next agent gateway restart.
settings.autoScheduleUnavailable: This backend doesn't support this toggle (version may be too old); not configurable for now.
